name: blue-fantasy
description: 为客户端界面应用蓝色幻想主题，营造魔幻美感。
descriptionEn: Applies a blue fantasy visual theme to the client interface, creating a magical aesthetic.

name: open-sea-skin
description: 基于WebGPU的海洋主题皮肤，提供原生插件、静态安装与新标签页扩展形式。
descriptionEn: WebGPU ocean skin for DeepSeek Harness, Chrome and Edge — native plugin, static installer, and new-tab extension.

name: dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine
description: 一个插件让你的dsh可以自由切换你的wallpaper engine里面的壁纸资源，还可以通过多个滑动条来控制透壁纸的模糊程度，亮度，边框，以及对话框的液态玻璃效果，让你的dsh更加美观
descriptionEn: Switches Wallpaper Engine wallpapers and adjusts blur, brightness, border, and glass effects for a more polished look.

name: seektty
description: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可插拔的 DeepSeek 配色终端皮肤。
descriptionEn: Pluggable DeepSeek-colored TUI for DeepSeek Harness

name: dsh-client-liang-intensity-skin
description: DeepSeek Harness 滑动变阻器皮肤
descriptionEn: A sliding rheostat skin that changes the visual appearance of DeepSeek Harness to resemble a physical dimmer switch.

name: dsh-skin-market
description: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供皮肤市场，可能提供主题皮肤以自定义外观。
descriptionEn: Provides a skin market for DeepSeek Harness, likely offering theme skins for customization.

name: @eternalnight/dsh-theme
description: 提供内置主题、静态图片和动态360跟随视频的皮肤插件。
descriptionEn: DeepSeek Harness theme skin plugin - built-in themes / static image / dynamic 360-follow video.

name: @lynn123411/dsh-a6api
description: 提供仿 Harness 官网的深色主题，含极光、粒子鲸鱼、星座网格、玻璃拟态等视觉效果。
descriptionEn: Provides a dark theme mimicking the Harness website with aurora, particle whale, constellation grid, glassmorphism, border beam, and thinking orbs effects.

name: @dfy-plugins/dsh-appearance
description: 自定义 DeepSeek Harness 的外观，包括颜色、字体和布局样式。
descriptionEn: Customizes the visual appearance of DeepSeek Harness, including colors, fonts, and layout styles.

name: @xmanrui/dsh-im
description: 通过扫码或机器人凭据把IM机器人接入DeepSeek Harness（支持飞书、微信、钉钉、企业微信、QQ、Telegram、Discord和WhatsApp）。 Connect IM bots to DeepSeek Harness via QR code or credentials (8 channels).
descriptionEn: Connects IM bots to DeepSeek Harness via QR code or credentials across eight chat platforms.

name: dsh-pocket
description: 把 DeepSeek Harness 装进你的口袋：电脑上跑 dsh web，手机扫码即同步访问（局域网 + 公网，实时同屏）
descriptionEn: Lets users access their local DeepSeek Harness web instance from a phone via QR code, syncing over LAN or public network.

name: dsh-notification
description: 回合完成桌面通知，按结果分控 + 关键词过滤。
descriptionEn: Desktop notifications for turn completions, with per-outcome controls and keyword rules.

name: @openma/deepseek-harness-acp
description: ACP profile 插件与独立 stdio server，可从 Zed 等 ACP 客户端使用完整 DSH agent，并共享 DSH 凭据与会话。
descriptionEn: ACP profile plugin and standalone stdio server for using the full DSH agent from Zed and other ACP clients while sharing DSH credentials and sessions.

name: dsh-wechat
description: DSH插件，将微信私聊消息桥接到DSH，支持文本、图片、文件、音视频的双向传输。目标是在微信端还原DSH的原生体验
descriptionEn: Bridges WeChat private messages to the harness, supporting bidirectional text, files, and media transfer.

name: dsh-bell-notify
description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 社区插件：为 Agent 生命周期事件合成铃声 + 右下角呼吸状态点，每个事件可上传自定义音频。dsh plugin that rings bells and shows a breathing status dot for Agent lifecycle events.
descriptionEn: Rings bells and shows a breathing status dot for Agent lifecycle events, with custom audio support.

name: dingtalk-dsh-assistant
description: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的钉钉群聊常驻个人助理插件
descriptionEn: Integrates DeepSeek Harness with DingTalk group chats, acting as a persistent assistant that responds to messages in real time.

name: @alanzhao/dsh-balance-monitor
description: 监控DeepSeek账户余额，低于阈值时发送提醒。
descriptionEn: Monitors DeepSeek account balance and sends alerts when it drops below a threshold.

name: dsh-plugin
description: 桥接DeepSeek Harness与Emacs，实现从编辑器无缝交互与控制。
descriptionEn: Bridges DeepSeek Harness with Emacs, enabling seamless interaction and control from the editor.

name: dsh-reach
description: 将工作区的审批与问题卡片推送到微信等IM渠道，支持远程回复和控制。
descriptionEn: Multi-channel decision & remote-control bridge for DeepSeek Harness: pushes any workspace's approval/question cards to IM channels (WeChat iLink first) and answers them from chat, with a session console, per-channel security, and an open push service.

name: dsh
description: 为 Codex、Claude Code 等 AI 工具提供可选的动画宠物图库，增添趣味互动。
descriptionEn: Provides a public gallery of animated pets that adds playful companions to AI harnesses like Codex and Claude Code.

name: dsh-whale-widget
description: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）一只住在 DSH 界面右下角的小鲸鱼娘，帮你盯着DeepSeek账户余额。QQ弹弹，支持拖拽吸附、左吸附翻转、数字滚动动画，随界面自动启用，建议直接喊来你的dsh安装
descriptionEn: Adds an interactive whale character to the DSH interface that monitors account balance with animations.

name: @open-pets/dsh
description: 桌面伴侣平台，带动画宠物与编程代理集成，为工作区增添趣味互动角色。
descriptionEn: Desktop companion platform with animated pets and coding-agent integrations, adding playful interactive characters to your workspace.

name: dsh-ads
description: 2005 年中文站点风格的整活广告插件：侧栏广告/信息流/角落弹窗 + 假关闭叉，素材全虚构。
descriptionEn: Parody ads in 2005-Chinese-web style: sidebar banners, in-chat feeds, corner popups, and a close button whose hit area is smaller than it looks. All fictional.

name: dsh-pet
description: DSH Web UI 桌宠：25 组透明动画、屏幕漫游、点击互动与拖拽，附可复现的素材生成流水线。
descriptionEn: Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI with 25 transparent animations, screen wandering, click reactions and drag, plus a reproducible asset-generation pipeline.

name: dsh-purge
description: DeepSeek Harness 破甲：让所有模型都能破甲，不同模型可换不同提示词；默认提示词面向国模「小码酱」。Jailbreak for every model — swap prompts per model. 求 Star 收藏 ⭐
descriptionEn: Bypasses content restrictions on various models with customizable jailbreak prompts, defaulting to a Chinese-specific persona.

name: whale-girl
description: 桌面宠物（QQ 宠物形态）：右下角悬浮、可拖拽/投喂/玩耍。
descriptionEn: Desktop pet (QQ-pet style): floats in the corner, draggable, feedable, playable.

name: dsh-web-search-pro
description: 增强型、可持久化的网页搜索：多引擎路由（DeepSeek/Exa/DDG/Bing/Jina + GitHub/B站/YouTube/V2EX/小红书/Twitter/Reddit/RSS）、SQLite+LRU 缓存、userscript 风格抽取、Playwright 渲染。
descriptionEn: Persistent enhanced web search: multi-engine routing (DeepSeek/Exa/DDG/Bing/Jina + GitHub/Bilibili/YouTube/V2EX/Xiaohongshu/Twitter/Reddit/RSS), SQLite+LRU cache, userscript-style extraction, Playwright rendering.

name: dsh-token-pet
description: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 用量小宠物：逐帧运行状态反馈、上下文与终身 Token 用量可视化。
descriptionEn: A desktop pet that animates token usage and provides real-time feedback on context and lifetime consumption.

name: @yejiming/dsh-gomoku
description: 与 AI 下五子棋，也可让 AI 对局比棋力。
descriptionEn: Play Gomoku against the AI, or let two AIs battle it out.
